facts.business: Sainik Finance & Industries Limited is a Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) engaged in advancing loans.

auditor.name: M/s Rakesh Kumar & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note 39 regarding loans where no principal or interest has been received but terms provide for payment at expiry; Company confident of recovery and has obtained confirmations.

key_risks: Impairment on financial assets (expected credit losses) involving significant estimation in grouping borrowers, staging loans, and determining behavioural life.
Recovery risk on loans where no principal or interest has been received yet, reliant on loan agreement terms and party confirmations.
